data.title: Peninsula
data.about:
Welcome to a breathtakingly beautiful residential paradise at Dubai’s Business Bay. This is Peninsula, inspired by an oasis, this project is an ideal place to find your home. It is surrounded by the canal on three sides and is flush with greenery in every corner. With stunning views of the waters, this is the best place to find your calm. It is crafted to perfection by Select Group.

They are known in the city for their mesmerising waterfront residences, and has developed the amazing Jumeirah Living Marina Gate, the highest selling waterfront residences in Dubai Marina. It is at an amazing location at Business Bay. Choose from studios, 1, 2, and 3 BR apartments and 1 to 4 BR Waterfront Duplexes with stunning views.

characteristics_module.title: Exclusive Lifestyle-Enriched Community in Business Bay
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Stunning waterfront apartments on the Dubai Canal
  • Located in Business Bay
  • Studios, 1, 2, 3 BR Apartments
  • 1 to 4 BR Waterfront duplexes
  • Studios starting at AED 886K
  • Ready in Q4 2024
  • Pay 5% on booking | 35% during construction | 60% on handover
  • Features a plethora of retail, cafes, restaurants, mall as well as supermarket, daycare & pharmacies
  • Striking Promenade with jogging tracks and plenty of green parks around
  • Waterfront living along the Dubai Canal with Direct Access to the Dubai Canal
  • Compelling Investment Opportunity

location_tile.title: Peninsula is located on an actual peninsular land in Dubai Canal.
location_tile.description:
It is easily accessible from Downtown Dubai and Sheikh Zayed Road. With stunning views of the Canal from every apartment, these homes are nestled in hte perfect gated community with amazing amenities and surroundings.

  • 07 min – Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa| Business Bay Metro Station
  • 06 min – Dubai Opera
  • 11 min – Dubai Design District
  • 12 min – Meydan | DIFC
  • 14 min – Dubai Healthcare City
  • 15 min – Ras al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
  • 16 min – Dubai International Airport
